description: Extractive summary: returns the first sentences of the text (default 3, up to 10) capped at max_chars (default 600, 50-2000), taken from the first 4000 characters. Deterministic; it does not paraphrase. `truncated` is true when the source was longer than the considered window. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.
name: summarize
title: Summarize text (extractive)
